machine.label: Hosted Linux x86_64; not a mid-range laptop or phone

method.quality: Lossless compares every decoded RGBA byte, including RGB under zero alpha. Lossy rows are measured with native SSIMULACRA2; matching is a separate sweep, never equal quality-slider values.
method.native: CLI process wall time includes process start, input PNG decode and output write. Each repetition starts a fresh process; these are repeated-process times, not warm in-process encode times.
method.peakMemory: Node uses process.resourceUsage().maxRSS. Native CLI uses resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) in a fresh Python parent. All include process/runtime/input. Browser memory unavailable is null, never zero.
method.gpu: Node tests are CPU-only. No claim about hardware WebGPU or phone/laptop targets.

scope: One hosted EPYC Linux instance, Node24 and Chrome155. Not a physical midrange laptop/phone qualification. All input/output byte and correctness facts are reproducible; latency is machine/load-specific. Native CLI repeats include startup and PNG decode, JS timings exclude input decode. Explicitly inspect each row timing and memoryMethod.
